entry.title: How Megan Lieu Grew From 5K to 16K Email Subscribers in 6 Months

media:group.media:title: How Megan Lieu Grew From 5K to 16K Email Subscribers in 6 Months
media:group.media:description:
Megan Lieu grew her email list from roughly 5K to more than 16K subscribers in just five to six months—but growth was only the beginning.
In this video, Megan explains how she turns Instagram followers into email subscribers, segments her audience for more relevant launches, and uses Kit’s Subscriber Signals to understand the people behind the metrics. By looking at influence, engagement, and buying signals, her team can identify the right audience for an offer and decide who is ready to hear a direct pitch versus who needs more nurturing.
For Megan, email isn’t just another channel. It’s where she builds deeper relationships with the most intentional part of her 500K-person audience.
